title: Business Development and Marketing Executive
description:
An excellent opportunity has arisen for a proactive and enthusiastic Business Development & Marketing Executive to join a highly regarded professional services firm in Norwich. This is a full time maternity cover fixed term contract position with an immediate start possible.

Working closely with senior stakeholders, you will play a key role in supporting a wide range of business development, marketing, events and client engagement activities. This is a varied position offering exposure to both strategic and hands-on marketing initiatives within a collaborative and professional environment.

Key responsibilities:
- Supporting business development plans and initiatives across multiple teams
- Organising and attending events, seminars, webinars and networking activities
- Producing presentations, delegate packs and marketing materials
- Assisting with proposals, tenders, credentials and client pitches
- Maintaining CRM records and key contact information
- Coordinating legal directory submissions and PR opportunities
- Managing social media promotion and content distribution
- Assisting with internal and external communications
- Taking meeting notes and following up on agreed actions
- Supporting a variety of ad hoc business development and marketing projects

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience within a Business Development, Marketing or Events role
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience producing professional presentations and marketing materials
- The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously
- A proactive and enthusiastic approach
- A full UK driving licence and willingness to attend events outside of normal working hours when required

In return, our client offers the opportunity to join a successful and supportive organisation with an excellent reputation, where you can further develop your career within a dynamic and growing team.

To find out more, please get in touch Emily at Pure for more information.

title: Marketing Content Executive
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a successful and respected digital business operating one of the UK's leading independent financial comparison platforms. As a Customer Journey & Content Specialist, you will play a key role in enhancing customer engagement, improving digital journeys, and creating high-performing content that drives traffic, conversions, and revenue growth.

This position is ideal for a creative, data-driven content professional with a strong understanding of SEO, emerging AI technologies, and user experience optimisation.

The Role

Working within a collaborative digital team, you will take ownership of customer-facing content across multiple channels, ensuring users can easily access relevant information and products. Acting as a subject matter expert in content strategy and customer journeys, you will work closely with SEO specialists and key stakeholders to maximise visibility across search engines, AI-driven platforms, and social channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Create, manage, and optimise engaging content across the customer journey.
- Produce content for websites, social media, video, podcasts, and other digital channels.
- Identify opportunities to improve engagement, conversion rates, and revenue.
- Develop content strategies aligned with SEO best practices and AI search experiences.
- Analyse content performance, user behaviour, and engagement metrics.
- Enhance user experience through data-led content improvements.
- Collaborate with internal teams to align content with business objectives.
- Provide support and guidance to team members where required.
- Stay up to date with emerging digital, content, and AI trends.

About You

We are seeking an experienced content professional with a proven track record in a consumer-focused digital environment.

Essential Skills & Experience
- Experience in digital content production for a consumer-facing brand.
- Strong SEO knowledge and practical application.
- Experience creating content for AI-powered search and discovery platforms.
- Proficiency with AI tools and technologies.
- Strong analytical and reporting skills.
- Experience creating and editing short-form video content.
- Previous people management experience.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proactive, hands-on approach with strong collaboration skills.
- Professional, adaptable, and flexible mindset.
- Full right to work in the UK (sponsorship is not available).

Desirable
- Social media content creation or management.
- Financial services, fintech, or comparison website experience.
- A/B testing experience.
- Knowledge of customer journey optimisation and conversion improvement techniques.

Benefits

Our client offers an excellent benefits package, including:
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Additional long-service holiday entitlement.
- Birthday leave.
- Enhanced pension scheme.
- Employee Assistance Programme and 24/7 GP access.
- Group Life Insurance.
- Ongoing training and career development.
- Free on-site parking and EV charging points.
- Modern, air-conditioned offices with shower and locker facilities.
- Staff incentives and workplace perks.
- Discounted local bus travel.

This role is fully office-based in Norwich within a collaborative and innovative environment.

title: Marketing Executive
description:

Contract: 18-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Salary: Competitive + Excellent Benefits

title: Ppc
description:
We have an exciting role with our client based in Norwich who are looking to recruit a Biddable Manager to manage their large paid social media and PPC campaigns. This role is offering flexibility for home working.

The role responsibility will be to drive the maximum number of quality leads into the business.

Main Responsibilities
- Management of Paid Social channels for 3 national market leading brands with laser focus on ROI.
- Working with eight figure budgets on diverse range of biddable accounts, platforms (e.g. Meta, Google & Microsoft) and campaign types (e.g. Paid Social, Search, Pmax, Demand Gen).
- Developing & implementing audience (including first party data) and creative strategies which drive performance and growth for paid social channels.
- Optimising and briefing the wider team to create bespoke landing pages for paid social to maximise the volume of high-quality leads.
- Manage bids utilising an array of fully automated bidding solutions to offline conversion actions.
- Digital agency and supplier liaison from tech providers and key media owners including Google, Meta, Microsoft Ads.
- Collaborate with an award-winning London based Search agency to implement cutting edge PPC technology.
- Collaborate with tech platform Account and Industry managers to optimise campaigns and drive performance delivery.
- Martech usage including Google Marketing Platform (Campaign Manager, Search Ads 360, Display Video 360). Other martech including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Bing Ads, Bot Management tool.
- Report into Biddable Media Lead to ensure all activity falls in line with the wider paid media strategy.

Performance measures
- Primary Paid Media metrics such as cost per acquisition and return on investment/advertising spend.
- Secondary Paid Media metrics including of cost per click, click through rate, conversion rate.
- Spend to planned budget & cost of sale % by region by product.

Knowledge and Experience
- Digital marketing background (either client or agency side).
- Minimum of 2-4 years' experience of hands-on management of large paid social campaigns and budgets.
- Excellent analytical skills.
- Able to communicate effectively in verbal and written formats.
- Proficient user of Microsoft packages.
- Knowledge of Google Marketing Platform particularly CM & SA360.
- Experience in Lead Generation preferrable
- Knowledge of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads interfaces and Editors (although full training will be given).
- Specific Digital Marketing qualifications.
- Meta Blueprint certified

Please apply with your updated CV.

title: Senior Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Location: Office-based, initially in Dereham, with the option to work from another Sowerbys office by agreement. Occasional travel across Norfolk is required.

Reports to: Marketing Director

Salary: Negotiable

Hours: Full-time

Sowerbys is one of Norfolk's leading independent estate agents. We're looking for a commercially minded Senior Digital Marketing Specialist with extensive hands-on Meta advertising experience to take ownership of our digital marketing across residential sales, lettings and new homes.

You'll understand what works across paid and organic social media - and why. You'll plan campaigns, analyse performance and audience behaviour, and turn those insights into commercial recommendations that improve results.

Creativity is equally important. You'll develop engaging campaigns, content and video ideas while ensuring everything we produce feels unmistakably Sowerbys.

Working closely with our Marketing Director, you'll lead the day-to-day delivery of our digital activity and line manage one member of the digital marketing team. You'll also collaborate with our wider Marketing and Visual Media team to deliver joined-up campaigns that build our brand, generate high-quality enquiries and produce measurable results.

What you'll be doing:
- Taking ownership of Sowerbys' digital marketing activity and helping shape its direction.
- Planning, building and managing paid social campaigns, particularly through Meta Ads Manager.
- Managing campaign objectives, audiences, budgets, creative formats, tracking, testing, optimisation and reporting.
- Analysing paid and organic social performance, audience behaviour, lead quality, website activity, conversions and return on investment.
- Turning data and campaign findings into clear recommendations for the Marketing Director and wider business.
- Continually testing and refining audiences, content, creative and campaign approaches.
- Planning integrated campaigns across social media, email, website and other digital channels.
- Overseeing the social media content calendar and using performance insights to guide future content.
- Writing engaging social posts, website content, blogs and emails in the Sowerbys tone of voice.
- Developing ideas, scripts and briefs for brand films, property films and social video, working with our videographers, photographers and presenters.
- Supporting improvements to website content, landing pages and customer journeys.
- Supporting our SEO strategy through keyword-led content and on-page optimisation.
- Managing email marketing and making better use of customer data and segmentation.
- Creating tailored digital plans for important residential sales, lettings and new homes opportunities, including high-value properties and key developments.
- Producing monthly performance reports, managing budgets and working with relevant agencies and suppliers.
- Line managing one team member, setting priorities, overseeing their workload and supporting their development.
- Building strong relationships with our offices and helping colleagues understand how digital marketing contributes to their success.

What we're looking for:

You'll be commercially minded, analytical and creative, with the confidence to take ownership, challenge existing approaches and make evidence-based recommendations.

You should have:
- Extensive hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager, including building campaigns from the ground up, developing audiences, allocating budgets, testing creative, optimising performance and reporting results.
- A proven record of improving lead quality, cost per enquiry, conversions or return on investment through paid social campaigns.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign, social media and website data into commercial recommendations.
- A detailed understanding of audience behaviour and the content that generates engagement, enquiries and conversions.
- Experience managing organic social channels and using performance insights to guide content.
- Broad digital marketing experience across several channels. Knowledge of LinkedIn Campaign Manager and other paid platforms would be advantageous.
- Strong creative judgement and the ability to develop ideas for campaigns, property marketing and video.
- Excellent copywriting and proofreading skills, including writing scripts and creative briefs.
- A good understanding of SEO and how content, websites and search work together.
- Working knowledge of content management systems, Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.
- Experience managing campaigns, budgets and deadlines, with excellent attention to detail and a genuine sense of ownership.
- The confidence to work with colleagues at every level and provide clear direction while maintaining high standards.
- Previous experience managing, supervising or developing another team member would be advantageous.
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own car, as occasional travel across Norfolk is required.
- Experience in property or another lifestyle-led brand would be useful, but isn't essential. What matters most is your ability to combine paid social expertise and intelligent performance analysis with strong creative judgement and measurable commercial results.

Why join Sowerbys?

You'll play an important role in shaping the digital presence of a well-established Norfolk brand. As part of our experienced in-house Marketing and Visual Media team, you'll have the freedom to bring forward ideas, test new approaches and create work you can genuinely be proud of.

To apply: Please send your CV with examples of paid social campaigns you have personally managed, including their objectives, your role, approach and results if appropriate. We would also welcome examples of content, writing, creative campaigns or video projects.
